display_title: Even if You Can't Eat, Go
description:
Jo Tae-san is a man who has lived his life with the sole determination to “protect his family,” driven by the memory of a father who ruined their home through gambling and violence.

His wife, Kang Jin-hee, is having an affair with a thug, even going so far as to film explicit videos with him. Then, his life takes a sudden turn when he is diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer.

Realizing he is facing death, he can no longer hold back. He begins to live his life completely differently, unleashing the anger, urges, and desires he has long suppressed.
